row.body: A house key is enclosed with a request for help; the reply box is marked delivered, though the envelope was never sealed.
row.title: A key left for help

sidecar.gloss: A help request is marked delivered while its envelope remains open.
sidecar.rival_reading: A program office could have logged an unsealed message as delivered; the key does not say who was meant to respond.

row.body: a broken barrier board crushed the antibiotics against the folded road map. clean undersides show both were there before the road was blocked.
row.title: missing count beside the antibiotics

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
